{"metadata":{"description":"Context-inheriting side tasks for DeepSeek Harness, opened in the right sidebar without cluttering the session list.","id":"gh:1442461815","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-side-tasks","slug":"QingJ01/dsh-side-tasks","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Context-inheriting side tasks for DeepSeek Harness, opened in the right sidebar without cluttering t"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ng side tasks for DeepSeek Harness, opened in the right sidebar without cluttering the session list."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Side Tasks"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文文档"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A dual-face DeepSeek Harness plugin for temporary, Codex-style side chats. It creates an independent"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" root Session (`origin: sidechat`) visible only in the right sidebar. The source contributes bounded"},{"id":"p4s3","text":", one-way text context; it is never resumed or changed."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- A small **Side chat** icon at the right of the conversation header; it prepares one idle child in "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"the current right-sidebar pane, then renders Harness's native Conversation and composer, including i"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ts editor, command menu, permission controls, and send/stop behavior. No handwritten first-message i"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"nput or synthetic prompt is used.
- Native model/reasoning and permission-preset menus. User choices"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" persist on the child only; they do not change the parent or the global model default. Full access r"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"etains Harness's risk confirmation.
- A native card on the right sidebar's Start page, using Harness"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"'s `IconNewChatOutlineRegular` and opening the same native side chat.
- The side chat starts empty a"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"nd keeps its own transcript and usage. The parent's completed-turn conversation is attached as per-a"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"gent prompt context, so the model continues with it while the footer counts only the side chat's own"},{"id":"p6s10","text":" work.
- A centered temporary-chat notice while the child is empty.
- New chats use Harness's native"},{"id":"p6s11","text":" root controller and native Conversation/composer; each child owns its model, permissions, transcrip"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"t, usage, and draft.
- Completion leaves the chat available for follow-up. Only explicit close stops"},{"id":"p6s13","text":" and archives; collapsing the sidebar is not close.
- Context is limited to 120 human/assistant mess"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"ages and 100,000 characters, refreshed on cold attach, and recorded on the child log rather than cop"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"ied into its transcript.
- Legacy continuable chats are never resumed or sent to. They show a migrat"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"ion notice; cold legacy sessions may be safely archived, while resident ones require a Harness resta"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"rt first.
- Creation requires both the Host `SessionController` and Client workspace side-chat capab"},{"id":"p6s18","text":"ilities. Missing or old capabilities fail visibly before the source is read or a child is created; t"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"here is no ordinary-session or subagent fallback."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0`
- Node.js `>=24.9.0` for development
- A Web profile built "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"from Harness RC.5 with the side-chat adapter applied. The patch, safe apply helper, and bilingual in"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"structions are in this repository's `compat/`; they are not included in the npm tarball. Stock RC.5 "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"e in this repository's `compat/`; they are not included in the npm tarball. Stock RC.5 fails closed."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**0.1.0 is released.** Install from npm or see the v0.1.0 release and the changelog. To run from sou"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"1.0 is released.** Install from npm or see the v0.1.0 release and the changelog. To run from source:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The compatibility patch and safe apply helper are repository-distributed under `compat/`, not includ"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ed in the npm tarball. Apply the patch to a clean pinned RC.5 Harness source checkout, then build th"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"e source profile. The helper requires the exact pinned commit and a clean tracked tree, checks the p"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"atch before applying it, and never downloads code or modifies an installed runtime:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The verified recipe installs into and launches the same `web` profile using the patched source CLI. "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"Replace the plugin path with your checkout's absolute path. Desktop installation is not covered by t"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" plugin path with your checkout's absolute path. Desktop installation is not covered by this recipe."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"For local development after editing the same version, remove before adding; pnpm does not re-expand "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"a same-version `file:` tarball:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Behavior"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Action | Result |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Create a side chat | Reads the source through query-only observation and creates an independent ro"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ot Session in the right sidebar. |
| Close the corresponding tab | Authenticates the child's own des"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"criptor and origin, then stops and archives only that child. |
| Merely collapse the right sidebar |"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" Does not close the tab or trigger archival. |
| Click **Side chat** again | Expands and focuses the"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" existing tab without creating another child; an already visible sidebar stays open. |
| Reload with"},{"id":"p19s6","text":" an unsent draft | The native Session body remains mounted even for an empty chat, retaining Harness"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"'s browser-local draft persistence. |
| Task completes | Leaves the child open and usable; follow-up"},{"id":"p19s8","text":" remains available. Completion never archives it. |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Deletion semantics:** Harness exposes durable archival, not physical deletion of session logs thro"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ugh its public plugin API. This plugin uses that supported lifecycle and never edits session files d"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"irectly. The UI describes this as ending and removing the temporary chat, not erasing its files."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Child settings:** The native Conversation owns the only model/reasoning and permission menus, usin"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"g the child's native Session controller. The Harness adapter keeps sidechat model choices out of the"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" shared default. Model/reasoning, preset, working directory, and effective permission choices are ca"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ptured through query-only source reads and restored from the child's own durable records. The source"},{"id":"p21s5","text":" is never resumed, activated, or written. The compatibility configuration endpoint still validates t"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"he child's independent origin and own descriptor and delegates model choices to that same native con"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"'s independent origin and own descriptor and delegates model choices to that same native controller."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Legacy chats:** Existing continuable side-task addresses are recognized only to show a migration n"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"otice and offer a safe close path. A cold legacy child can be archived after a query-only ownership "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"check. A resident legacy child is refused; restart the patched Harness first, then close it or creat"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"e a new independent side chat. The plugin never resumes, configures, or sends to legacy children and"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" does not rewrite historical logs."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The package has Host (`src/index.ts`) and browser (`src/client/index.ts`) faces. `src/client/sidebar"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"-chat.tsx` owns the resource, empty state, and tab adapter. Remote metadata embeds the protocol's la"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"zy info factory so profile-level protocol hoisting cannot break the subpath import; authorization re"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"aders name the source or child Session IDs directly.
